name: Opposite π/2 scalars
summary: Legless spiders with phases π/2 and −π/2 together are the scalar 2.
description:
Legless Z-spiders with phases π/2 and −π/2 are the scalars $1+i$ and $1-i$, whose product is 2. Diagrammatically, 2 is two copies of the phase-free [two-spider scalar](../scalar-state-effect/) √2.

Together with the [two π/2 scalars](../scalar-pi2-pair/) rule, this allows all Clifford scalar diagrams to be brought to a normal form.
